reviewItem.question: Does "`cilium_fqdn_selectors` is a new metric counting the number of ingested `toFQDNs` selectors" mean a change to protocol-behavior:cilium|name=cilium-fqdn-selectors-metric (added)?

proposed.statement: cilium_fqdn_selectors is a new metric counting the number of ingested toFQDNs selectors; it has no operational consequence for operators.
